novel_features.name: Lien-chain reconstruction
novel_features.description: See every recording ever filed against a property in one chronological timeline — deeds, mortgages, satisfactions, lis pendens, federal tax liens, assignments — without manually deed-walking owner-by-owner.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating Property-search deeds (returns DEE/QCD only) with per-grantee Name-search results (returns mortgages/liens/lis pendens by name), then filtering back to the target folio via the subdivision + plat_book + plat_page + block_no composite signature. No single portal endpoint produces this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is asked for the full encumbrance history on a Miami-Dade property (foreclosure underwriting, title research), this is the single command that produces it — bypassing the portal's split index.

novel_features.name: Surviving-liens calculator
novel_features.description: Tells you which liens on a property will survive a foreclosure or tax-deed sale, with totals in cents — Federal Tax Liens always survive tax deed; junior mortgages get wiped on senior foreclosure; HOA liens cap at FL Statute 720/718 safe-harbor amounts.
novel_features.rationale: Requires pairing every lien-type record (MOR/LIE/FTL/JUD/LIS) against its corresponding release record (SAT/REL by linK_DOCTYPE backreference) using local SQLite, then applying the static Florida lien-survivability table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Computes the real Max Safe Bid for a foreclosure or tax-deed auction property. Pre-CLI, this number required a $150-300 O&E report from a title company.

novel_features.name: Chain of title
novel_features.description: Returns the ordered list of every deed conveying a property, with grantor, grantee, consideration, and recording date — and detects gaps where a grantee doesn't match the next deed's grantor.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite query filtered to deed doc-type codes (DEE, QCD, DAM, DM, ODE) ordered by recording date, with a custom gap-detector pass.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The title-industry-standard 60-year chain-of-title deliverable, in one command. Agents can verify clean title before recommending a bid.

novel_features.name: Owner portfolio scan
novel_features.description: Give a person or LLC name and see everything Miami-Dade has on them: every folio they appear on, every active mortgage or lien they've taken, every lis pendens or judgment against them.
novel_features.rationale: Single Name search + post-processing groups results into three entity-centric buckets via local SQLite joins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lead-gen for off-market deals and risk signal for already-distressed owners. Answers 'has this LLC defaulted elsewhere?' in one call.

novel_features.name: Litigation arc tracker
novel_features.description: Walks a single court case across all its recorded documents in chronological order: lis pendens → final judgment → certificate of title → satisfaction, with a status classifier (open / judgment-entered / sale-complete / dismissed).
novel_features.rationale: Mechanical doc-type sequence walker over records with matching case_number; classifies arc status from the doc-type pattern.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Complements case-docket sources by adding the recording-layer view — when a judgment was actually recorded, when the certificate of title issued, whether subsequent satisfactions cleared the lien.

novel_features.name: Folio-batch enrichment
novel_features.description: For a list of folios, compute lien-chain + surviving-liens + chain-of-title for each, and emit a single JSON file with totals_cents, surviving_lien_count, oldest_deed_date, last_deed_date, current_owner, FTL_count — designed for downstream ingest pipelines.
novel_features.rationale: Orchestrator of three transcendence features over a CSV input list; output shape optimized for Supabase ingest (cents, ISO-8601 dates, stable cfn_master_id).
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets a Tuesday-morning auction-prep workflow process 30+ properties in one invocation. The output JSON drops directly into a Supabase upsert.

novel_features.name: Federal Tax Lien scanner
novel_features.description: Find every Federal Tax Lien recorded after a given date, optionally filtered to a folio watchlist. FTLs survive tax-deed foreclosure, so any FTL on a TD-bound property is a deal-breaker red flag.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite filter on doc_type_code='FTL' AND recording_date >= since, optionally joined to a folio watchlist via the subdivision+plat+block signature.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The single highest-signal alert for tax-deed investors. Today the v3 underwriter's `uw_td_govt_liens` column has no upstream feed.

narrative.headline: Pull the full lien chain on any Miami-Dade property in 30 seconds — every deed, mortgage, satisfaction, lis pendens, and federal tax lien ever recorded.
narrative.value_prop: The Miami-Dade Clerk portal indexes deeds by property and everything else (mortgages, satisfactions, liens, lis pendens, judgments) by name. This CLI is the only tool that pivots property → owners → bounded name searches → filtered-back-to-property timeline, producing the chain-of-title and surviving-liens analysis that title companies charge $150-300 for.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public records, no API key. The clerk portal uses a NetScaler session cookie plus reCAPTCHA Enterprise v3 (invisible). Run `miami-dade-clerk-pp-cli auth login --chrome` once to capture a browser session, then every subsequent command replays through Surf transport with fresh reCAPTCHA tokens.

quickstart.comment: One-time browser-cookie capture so reCAPTCHA-gated calls replay through Surf.
Confirm session + portal reachability + recording-cutoff date.
Smoke test against a known Hialeah SFR (returns 14 deeds, 1995-2022).
The killer feature — full encumbrance timeline for one property.
Bulk auction-prep: 30+ folios in one pass, Supabase-ingest-ready.

troubleshoots.fix: The address is not in the clerk's property index (folio renumbering, recent subdivision). Use `lien-chain` instead — its 4-layer fallback recovers the chain via owner-name search.
Token expired. Re-run `auth login --chrome` to refresh the session cookie.
Hit the portal's 500-row cap. Narrow by `--doc-type <code>` (use `doc-types` to list) or shorter `--since`/`--until` window. The CLI's auto-pagination handles this when `--auto-narrow` is set.

troubleshoots.symptom: Condo unit search fails with unit number from address line
troubleshoots.fix: Use the unit from PA's legal_description (e.g. 'UNIT B312'), not the '#312' display form. The CLI does this automatically when given `--folio` instead of `--address`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need recorded-document data for Miami-Dade real estate: foreclosure auction underwriting (Max Safe Bid), title research (chain of title, open liens), owner due diligence (cross-property portfolio), or downstream ingest for an analytics pipeline. Best suited for property-by-property lookups (30-50 folios at a time); not a bulk-export tool.

recipes.title: Compute Max Safe Bid for a foreclosure auction property
recipes.explanation: Returns only the surviving-lien totals and per-lien details, suppressing the full record metadata. Pipe to the underwriter to compute auction Max Safe Bid.

recipes.title: 60-year chain of title for a title commitment
recipes.explanation: Walks every deed conveying the folio since 1965. Gap detector flags any chain breaks (grantee on one deed not matching grantor on the next).

recipes.title: Has this LLC defaulted elsewhere in Miami-Dade?
recipes.explanation: One Name search, post-processed into three buckets: properties owned, active mortgages/liens taken, lis pendens/judgments against. Lead-gen + risk signal.

recipes.title: Tuesday auction prep — bulk-enrich 30 folios
recipes.explanation: Orchestrates lien-chain + surviving-liens + chain-of-title for every folio in the CSV. Output JSON has totals_cents, FTL_count, current_owner per folio — drops directly into a Supabase upsert.

trigger_phrases: chain of title for this folio
what else does this owner control
federal tax liens on this folio
